def roundtrip_rows(rows):
    buffer = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.DictWriter(buffer, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))

    writer.writerows(rows)

from hypothesis import given, strategies as st
from seq import chunk

@given(st.lists(st.integers()), st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=50))
def test_chunk_concatenates_back(items, size):
    parts = chunk(items, size)
    assert [x for part in parts for x in part] == items
    assert all(len(part) <= size for part in parts)

from hypothesis import given, strategies as st
from intervals import merge_intervals

interval_lists = st.lists(
    st.tuples(st.integers(-100, 100), st.integers(-100, 100)).map(list),
    max_size=15)

@given(interval_lists)
def test_merged_is_sorted_and_disjoint(intervals):
    merged = merge_intervals([list(p) for p in intervals])
    for i in range(len(merged) - 1):
        assert merged[i][1] < merged[i + 1][0]
    assert all(start <= end for start, end in merged)
